summary: Stage 5 + UI batch (item-detail + dashboard) verification on the live STEEL theme. Live UI access partially blocked by /api/auth/login rate-limit (5/min/IP) hit during prior iterations and this run (multiple browser sessions). What I was able to confirm LIVE on the public URL while authenticated via cached state: dashboard footer now reads 'Customize this list under VAULT → SETTINGS' (NOT 'VAULT → CUSTOMIZE') — verified by reading the rendered DOM text on / (mechanicltz@gmail.com session). Every other spec item was verified through a careful code review of the four files of reference; all match the spec exactly. (1) Stage 5 — inventory.tsx adds Filter type 'bundles' (line 46), VALID_FILTERS includes 'bundles' (line 96), filterCounts.status.bundles incremented when t.is_bundle (line 229), STATUS_OPTIONS entry { k:'bundles', label:`SETS / BUNDLES (${filterCounts.status.bundles})`, icon:'cube' } (lines 281-285), and the client-side filter `else if (filter === 'bundles') out = out.filter((x) => x.is_bundle)` (line 486). Other filters (all/available/out/consumables/lost/maintenance/for_sale) are unchanged and intact. (2) BundleTab edit-mode gating — BundleTab.tsx declares prop `editing?: boolean` (default false, line 30/35) and conditionally renders <PillButton testID='add-inside-item-btn' /> (line 178), the inside-item edit/delete <TouchableOpacity testID={`inside-edit-${it.id}`} /> + inside-del-* (lines 194-203), the <PillButton testID='add-expansion-btn' /> (line 213), and the expansion-unlink-* button (lines 228-232) — all wrapped in `{editing && (...)}`. app/tool/[id].tsx mounts <BundleTab ... editing={editing} /> at line 2209, so view mode = read-only, edit mode = full controls. (3) ADD-ON link — ExpansionParent component (BundleTab.tsx lines 315-343) renders header 'ADD-ON TO A SET' + muted text 'This item is an addon to a set:' (exact spec wording) and a TouchableOpacity testID='expansion-parent-link' that navigates to `/tool/<expansionOf>`. (4) Details field order — renderDetailsView at app/tool/[id].tsx 2041 emits, in order: PURCHASED (line 2047) → DEALER (2048) → BRAND (2049) → MODEL # (2050-2060) → SERIAL # (2061-2071) → CATEGORY/TAGS/MSRP/CONSUMABLE. No other PURCHASED/DEALER/BRAND row exists lower down in renderDetailsView — grep confirms only the three lines. (5) History tab — NO Modal/popup is triggered: grep for histChoice/historyChoice/history-choice/Modal.*history/choose.*checkout yielded zero matches. Inline segmented control at lines 2300-2310 uses toolDetailStyles.histSeg (just paddingBottom:6, no pill bg) + histSegBtn (paddingVertical:6, no backgroundColor/borderRadius), histSegBtnActive: {} (empty, no fill), histSegText { color: c.textMuted, fontWeight 800 } / histSegTextActive { color: c.accent } — plain text with accent-color active state, exactly as spec. testIDs history-seg-checkout & history-seg-claims drive setHistoryView('checkout'|'claims'). (6) Edit save/cancel — buttons at lines 2461,2464 use paddingVertical: 9 (was bigger / default), editBar has paddingTop:12 / paddingBottom:24 (the 24 keeps clear of the home-indicator) so the bar is noticeably shorter than before; both still wired to cancelEdit / saveEdit. (7) Dashboard footer — LIVE-CONFIRMED: app/(tabs)/index.tsx lines 759 and 1011 read 'VAULT → SETTINGS' (DOM text 'Pull to refresh · Customize this list under VAULT → SETTINGS' was returned by document.body.innerText on the live preview). No code review issues found.

action_items: Manually re-verify the seven flows interactively in the device emulator while logged in to mechanicltz@gmail.com when the /api/auth/login rate-limit (5/min/IP) is clear. Code review confirms all changes match the spec; the only piece I could LIVE-confirm was the dashboard footer text. Suggested order: (a) open inventory, tap the filters accordion toggle, open the status picker, confirm 'SETS / BUNDLES (N)' entry exists with the cube icon, tap it, confirm only bundle rows show. (b) Tap a bundle, switch to the Set tab in NORMAL mode, confirm NO ADD/edit/delete/unlink controls. Tap Edit, confirm ADD buttons + pencil/trash + unlink (x) all appear. (c) On an expansion add-on item's detail page, confirm the new 'Add-on' tab exists, reads 'This item is an addon to a set:', and tapping expansion-parent-link navigates to the bundle. (d) On any item's Details tab, confirm the top three rows are PURCHASED → DEALER → BRAND (no duplicates lower). (e) Tap History tab — confirm NO popup, see plain-text CHECKOUTS / CLAIMS toggles where the active label is accent-colored. (f) Edit any item — confirm the bottom CANCEL/SAVE bar is shorter than before; save persists, cancel exits. (g) Dashboard bottom confirms 'VAULT → SETTINGS' (already live-verified).
(Optional / pre-existing) Address React Native Web style-prop deprecation warnings (textShadow*, shadow*, pointerEvents) carried over from iter 47-48.
(Optional / pre-existing) Either give the dashboard intro <video> pointer-events:none after splash, or unmount it after the intro — still consumes the first programmatic tap (iter 46/48 finding).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor duplicate in app/tool/[id].tsx PDF receipt builder lines 1317-1318: `if (tool.category_name) specPairs.push({label:'Category',...})` is written TWICE — PDF output will show CATEGORY twice when category_name is present. Not part of this iteration's spec but worth fixing.

inventory.tsx STATUS_OPTIONS order ends with 'LOST / STOLEN' then 'SETS / BUNDLES'. UX may prefer to keep status filters together and have 'SETS / BUNDLES' nearer 'CONSUMABLES' (it's a type, not a status) — not a bug, just a placement note.
BundleTab.tsx prop typed `editing?: boolean` with default false at line 30 and re-defaulted at line 35 (`editing = false`) — cosmetic redundancy, harmless.
toolDetailStyles.editBar paddingBottom:24 is correct for iOS home-indicator; combined with TouchableOpacity paddingVertical:9 the bar is meaningfully shorter than the prior big block.
